title: Good for a fast, lightweight storage solution.  Beware bent bars.
text:
Good for a fast, lightweight storage solution. Beware bent bars.. Pros: Simple instructions, easy to assemble, contained all the parts, looks nice.
Cons: 4 bars were bent, making it difficult to get the drawers pushed in and out. The box it arrived in was in perfect shape, so these were packed and shipped like that. I had to fix these as best as I could with a hammer, one was so bent up it was impossible for me to fix without making it worse. It's not the most sturdy dresser, I don't expect it to last long. I can see the drawers bowing out quickly.
Overall: Acceptable purchase if you are looking for a fast solution to a dresser shipped right to your house in a couple days. If you want a dresser that will last longer, spend a little more and get a solid wood one. it would probably serve better holding lightweight items like crafting supplies or toys/stuffed animals.
